name: com.xrprivacy.sdk
description: XR headsets stream your head, hand, and eye movement — and that motion is as unique as a fingerprint. This SDK perturbs it in real time so users are much harder to re-identify, without breaking the experience. It's the official implementation of the multimodal (gaze + body) privatization methods from our paper.

samples.description: Step-by-step setup guide for wiring the SDK into an XR scene.
